task.title: Set a node to maintenance mode by using the web console
task.shortdesc: To set a node to maintenance mode, you can create a NodeMaintenance custom resource (CR) by using the web console.

ul.li: Log in as a user with cluster-admin privileges.
Install the Node Maintenance Operator from the Software Catalog.

step.cmd: From the Administrator perspective in the web console, navigate to Operators → Installed Operators.
Select the Node Maintenance Operator from the list of Operators.
In the Node Maintenance tab, click Create NodeMaintenance.
In the Create NodeMaintenance page, select the Form view or the YAML view to configure the NodeMaintenance CR.
To apply the NodeMaintenance CR that you have configured, click Create.

result.p: In the Node Maintenance tab, inspect the Status column and verify that its status is Succeeded.
